messages:
Taylor: Quick catch: API ref for POST /v1/generate still mixes param names. The OpenAPI shows 'input' and 'max_tokens' but several inline examples (curl/python) use 'prompt' and 'max_new_tokens'. CI linted it in docs job. Can someone take this?

Ravi: Happy to own. Prefer we make the docs match the OpenAPI/backend ('input' + 'max_tokens') and add a short compatibility section showing old->new mappings.

Maya: Agreed. Also the streaming example is ambiguousit shows raw JSON lines but our SSE uses named events (chunk/done). We should add a clear SSE example with event names.

Ibrahim: Note: changing the OpenAPI response shape will force generated SDK snippets to change. I'll regen python/node/java snippets after the page is updated.

Taylor: Suggested plan: 1) update api-reference/generate.md request/response schema to canonical fields, 2) replace curl/python/node snippets, 3) add Migration notes and one-line Compatibility blurb at top, 4) include explicit SSE example.

DevRel: Also update the "See also" runnable samples link to point at github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples#generate (we keep canonical snippets there).

Maya: Draft SSE snippet to include in PR:
```
# curl SSE example
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"Write a short story","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# server sends:
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"Once upon"}
event: chunk
data: {"delta":" a time..."}
event: done
data: {"id":"resp_42","status":"complete"}
```

Ravi: I'll open branch docs/generate-cleanup and submit a PR. I'll run 'make docs-validate' locally before pushing.

Docs-bot: created issue #2481 -> PR 6222 opened by Ravi (label: docs:needs-review)

Ibrahim: After PR merges I'll re-run the snippet generator (pin generator v0.9.2) and push updated examples.

Taylor: Thanks all. Reviewers: @maya @ibrahim @devrel. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
